flawed_step: 0198 | The conclusion “Hence the code is self-dual” does not follow. The calculation only proves orthogonality between arbitrary codewords and codewords of the special form 2w, not self-orthogonality of all pairs of codewords.
counterexample: Over Z_4, let C be the length-2 code generated by (1,1). Then Tor_0(C)=Tor_1(C)={(0,0),(1,1)}, and Tor_0(C)=Tor_1(C)^perp. Nevertheless (1,1)·(1,1)=2 mod 4, so C is not self-orthogonal and hence not self-dual. Thus the theorem stated at 0188 is false.
assessment_summary: Verification stops at step 0198. The asserted torsion-code condition does not imply self-duality over Z_4, as the explicit counterexample demonstrates.
